notes.title: Pet Contest! Feature your pet in game!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10606530/4b595593dc2b65ae5f561b7ae359f8466813d054.png

Fam, you've shown us so much love over the years that we wanted to show our appreciation with a very special contest: Your pet can appear in Stars in the Trash! Yes, you heard it right. Select the best photos of your cat, dog, bird, fish, spider, you name it,  and participate! Some pets will be selected at random and others by number of votes.

Moreover, on the occasion of the Steam Next Fest the demo will be available again from today until the end of the contest.

All the details in this FAQ:

How can I participate?

As simple as uploading a photo of your pet through the form on the page: Pet Contest Link  💌

What are the prizes?

There are 6 prizes divided into two categories:

Category 1: Your pet will be featured in Star in the Trash video game as a NPC (Non-Player Character).

Category 2: A poster of your pet will be featured in Star in the Trash video game.

How are the winners chosen?

The 1st and 2nd most voted pets win a category 1 prize.
The 3rd and 4th most voted pets win a category 2 prize.

In order to give all pets a chance to appear in the game, one prize from each category will be randomly raffled among all participants.

How often can I vote?

You can vote once a day.

When is the contest over?

The promotion will run from 05/25/2024 at 00:00 GMT+1 to 06/23/2024 at 23:59 GMT+1

How can I increase my chances of winning?

Share with friends so you can get more votes.
If many people add Stars in the Trash to their wishlist we will increase the number of prizes.

Wishlist Star in the Trash

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1822240/Stars_In_The_Trash/


Do you have any questions? Write us at valhallacats@gmail.com

notes.title: AMA answers
notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10606530/2352aa6e04b6c392a15105123245b6a569855b0d.png

As I promised, here are the answers from AMA (Ask Me Anything). Many thanks to everyone for participating. Thank you for joining us in this adventure. These months are being especially hard and it’s comforting to know that you are here, supporting us. I wish you a great starting of the year.
 
Soldier of Light  

Hello! What is the storyline in your new game? How old is Tika? She's so adorable, we all love her! Happy new year

Hi. Happy New Year! Tika is 5 years old. Without going into much detail, Stars In The Trash tells a  story about a lazy cat, that leaves the comfort of its home and embarks on a dangerous journey to rescue his best dog friend.


Cécile Catina 

When do you think Stars in the Trash will be released?

It is still too soon to know it with certainty, but it will arrive at some point in 2019.

How old is Tika? (i know i shouldn't ask the age of a lady)

Tika is 5 years old (very well kept, by the way).

Will she be in Stars in The trash just like in the Purring Quest?

Definitely (we could be punished, if not). [Maybe not just like in The Purring Quest, but she can indeed be interacted with in Stars in the trash.]

Will her husband Magnus be?

We yet do not know how -interactively speaking- but he will be present in the game somehow.

How many of you are working on the project?

We are a tiny team. Currently there are only 2 people working in the project. Next year, an audio artist -Yevheniy- will join us too, to create the sounds and music.

Are you already planning something else after Stars in the Trash? 

We have some ideas in mind but everything will depend on how well Stars in the Trash goes.

Cat related or not?
 
There will be cats, but maybe not the way you expected from us... (mysterious music).


Darcalus
  
Would love to have a release date for Stars in the Trash. i would also love to have more wallpapers (they're fantastic!) Thanks for all of the hard work! 

Thank you, Darcalus. Write it down for 2019 in the calendar ;) . Don’t you worry. We have many wallpapers in the planning.


 RafLunarWinter 

I have a slight feeling that you guys love cats. Is that true?

Not at all, they are unfounded rumors. We hate them deeply :P
Jokes aside, it is evident that we feel a very special bond to them.

Ansgar 

I would also like to know -approximately- when "Stars in the Trash" will come out ... I hope you have had a happy Christmas and that you also enjoy the Year’s Eve. I hope you will be very successful; regards ! ! ! !

Hi, Ansgar. You too! The release date is on 2019, but we’re not able to specify more at this time.


Fabian 

Will your new game be available in the same languages as The purring quest? Will you include any others (For example: German, French, Portuguese)?

We will try to translate it to as many languages as possible from the day of release. Among them, there will be those you’ve named. 

Have you thought of adding any special theme in the game, for the holidays like Christmas or Halloween? (For instance, the protagonists wearing a Santaclaus hat when playing on Christmas).

For now, we are focusing on the default game. Depending on the game’s reception, we could add more content, but it all depends on how well it works.

Have you thought about adding a hidden extra in the game, for those of us who have The Purring Quest in our Steam library? (Same way as in “Killing Floor”, when you have the game “Dwarfs!”, sort of a secret DLC is revealed).

We will include some nods for the players of The Purring Quest. We can not say anything because it would ruin the surprise, but you can count them in. We like to hide a lot of easter eggs.

Will you add Steam trading cards to the game?

With no doubt.

Will the game carry funny designs of Steam achievement logos? (Example: "Letters formed by animals"?

It is still not decided, but it’s a good idea. We will do our best.

Will there be a piano mission again, even if it is optional to complete it?

No. Even though we know that many people enjoyed the piano minigame, it was an authentic nightmare to some people. 

Are the protagonists of the game inspired by real animals or have they been taken from your imagination?

Almost all of the animals that appear are drawn from imagination to paper by Javier -artistic director and animator of Valhalla Cats-. There will also be some real animals, such as the winners of the contest we will carry out next year and some others.

On what dates have you planned to make the contest for our pets to appear in the game?

During the second half of 2018.

Could you reveal something about the type of combat of the protagonist cat?

Sure. In a way, we can say that we’ve abandoned some realism in order to favor the fun. For example, now the protagonist stands on the hind paws to perform the attacks. Currently, we have implemented a prototype of basic (but fun) fight, with 4 combos that also allows us to throw or push enemies away.

Which one turned out to be the most difficult for you: "Compose the music", "The design of the drawings", "The script" or "Take 5 euros from Tika’s wallet"?

We have not started with the music yet. From the remaining points, perhaps the script is the one that is taking longer for us. Tika doesn’t need no wallet, since she has slaves who fulfill all her desires.

Without revealing any details, does the game take on a social issue of awareness? (Yes or no)

Yes, we want to transmit a message of awareness.

Approximate date of release of the game?

2019.

Will the egocentric and slaver (of humans) Tika show up in the game?
Let's see who is the one brave enough to tell her not to...

Is it true that Tika took you as a slave? She sent me a message saying "Tell my adoptive father to change the sand".

No, it's not true... (sounds of violent meows). Yes, yes, in the studio we are all servants of our beloved boss Tika.


 Mochi! 

How big your team?

We are a tiny team. Currently, it’s formed by only 2 members. In 2018, there will be 3 of us working in the project. 

Why this cat https://twitter.com/valhallacats/status/936318290208714763 looks like on my maine coon cat? (referring to the picture of a cat that visited the studio)

Well, this question is complicated… It seems that somebody made a long trip without letting you know… He swore us he told you! Anyway, don’t worry. We treated him very well and he met our boss Tika.

What is weather today? (in my location very damp, overcast, dirty and snowy 📷) 

We have a very pleasant weather. Clear skies and 20ºC (68ºF) of temperature at this very moment.

notes.title: PATCH 1.7 Smooth Camera and Parallax
notes.content:
Hi! Last week someone wrote me that he got motion sick playing the game. So I did some research into how people who are prone to motion sickness respond to the way characters move, how backgrounds move, and how the two move together. As a result now you can play with a smooth camera and parallax. I hope you all enjoy the improvement :)

On another front, during the last months I have been publishing on facebook a lot of stuff about The Purring Quest (early concepts, rejected animations of Kimchi, details about donations, etc). Don't forget to like the page to keep up to date!:  Facebook

http://www.valhallacats.com/wp-content/uploads/12916106_528694433969223_280217289848648155_o.jpg

notes.title: PATCH 1.4 Double Jump!
notes.content:
Double Jump!

Here you have the new update including one of the most demanded features by all of you: a new type of easier control based in double jump!

We know that a lot of people have enjoyed The Purring Quest with the original controls so we want to keep them and offer you the new one. 

We would love to know your opinion because it will help us to improve the new video games we will make. What type of control do you like the best?

http://www.valhallacats.com/wp-content/uploads/ControlTypeHD.png

[Note] If your version is earlier than 1.3 you have to Start a New Game. Don't click Continue before clicking New Game button.

notes.content:
Achievements, improved jumps and minor fixes

The new update generates a different savefile so you have to start a New Game. Once the new savefile is created you can play as always and unlock the achievement. Don't click Continue before clicking New Game button.

* Achievements!
* Adjustement in kimchi's colliders. Now the jumps are more accurate.
* The tutorial shows keys and xbox360 buttons. 
* Minor fixes.

http://www.valhallacats.com/wp-content/uploads/logros.png


I hope you enjoy the new update!

* Dozens of minor fixes and tweaks in the difficulty


Future plans:

* Better controller support

* More Languages
* Linux version

Currently I am the only person working on the studio so please be patient.

ENJOY!
